MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The speakers would give me a useful alternative to my headphones for desk audio, fitting my interest in making my everyday setup more comfortable.",
    "The tablet stand could make my Kindle easier to use for hands-free reading at my desk, provided it holds my device securely."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The CPU cooler, internal hard drive, case fan and SATA cable assume an internal computer upgrade project that I haven't shown a need for; cleaning and organizing my equipment serves a different purpose.",
    "Another HDMI cable or keyboard set would duplicate equipment I already have, while the USB-B cable solves a connection need I don't currently have.",
    "The Fire TV Cube doesn't address the practical desk and computer accessory needs behind my recent choices."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying computer accessories seems to have been taken as interest in almost any computer component, even when it requires a separate installation project.",
    "My cable and keyboard purchases seem to have been treated as reasons to buy more of the same, without considering whether I already filled those needs."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent backpack, headphone mount, Ethernet accessories and duster point toward carrying, organizing, connecting and maintaining equipment I already use.",
    "I choose cables for particular devices and connections, so the connector and intended use matter more than simply being another cable.",
    "An older purchase can still make a complementary accessory useful, as with a stand for my Kindle, without implying that I want a replacement device."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my interest in a useful desk setup but stretched it into unsupported upgrade projects and duplicate accessories."
}
